_meta.com.requstory/summary: Find B2B suppliers by product type, country, prices, minimum order and payment terms; dated facts.

description: Find independent B2B suppliers (wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers) in the Requstory Index to buy goods for a business: catering disposables and packaging, café and coffee supplies, cleaning and janitorial, packaging, fasteners, industrial and growing supplies, in the UK and US. Each result has dated trade facts: prices shown or quote on request (trade login), minimum order (with amount), payment terms, delivery and returns policies, trade account link, and whether an agent could order online. Verified suppliers confirmed their facts and rank first. Then use request_quote to ask a supplier for a price, stock or a delivery date. Use search_companies instead to look up a company's ease score or map.

maxMinimumOrder.description: Most the minimum order may be, in the supplier's currency. Suppliers with no stated minimum are kept.

payOnAccount.description: Only suppliers that state payment terms (for example 30 days on account).

prices.description: shown: prices on the website; quote: quote on request or trade login. Default any.

query.description: Product type or supplier name, e.g. "compostable cups", "coffee", "M8 bolts", "janitorial".

verifiedOnly.description: Only suppliers whose owner confirmed the listing.

name: search_suppliers
title: Search B2B suppliers
